objects.description: In the [Triton Safety Instrumented System Attack](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0030), [TEMP.Veles](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0088) used a publicly available PowerShell-based tool, WMImplant.(Citation: FireEye TEMP.Veles 2018)
objects.description_fa: در [Triton Safety Instrumented System Attack](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0030)، [TEMP.Veles](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0088) از یک ابزار عمومی مبتنی بر PowerShell، WMImplant استفاده کرد.(Citation: FireEye TEMP.Veles 2018)
